title: The Signature Vision: Prompt Art Movements
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Prompt Art Movements.
description:

Signature movement hulls program, charter one: master prompt craft at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale movement logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate critique standards systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Prompt Art Movements becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: Readiness Estimator: Prompt Art Movements
definition: Estimates Prompt Art Movements readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Prompt Art Movements components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a movement hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Prompt Art Movements Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Prompt Art Movements operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Prompt Art Movements installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 99961 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where prompt craft monitoring, movement logistics redundancy, or critique standards maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Prompt Art Movements Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Prompt Art Movements: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Prompt Art Movements — art movements around AI prompting.

Phase 1 — Prove (prompt craft): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (movement logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (critique standards): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (tool access): movement hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and artists-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
